cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Prove We’re Close
cards.instruction: Get someone to take a social or emotional risk that demonstrates trust in the connection.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Come to the reunion with me. Let them see us arrive holding hands.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They still think we're just friends.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I know. I want us to trust each other in that room too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Last time someone asked, you let go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll introduce you as my partner. Will you keep hold while I say it?

mechanism: A sets and authorizes a public relationship demonstration, then accepts a reciprocal exposure condition while still directing how the shared risk happens.
confusable: D73 asks presence; D80 requires a social or emotional risk that demonstrates trust.
comparison: A public hand-holding declaration differs from privately admitting a needy message.
seedUse: Use D80-a earlier letting go and proposed partner introduction; retain A responsibility for making B risk credible.
